name: rgcycle_day1_cyclenet_protocol
description: Day-1 pilot under the CycleNet (NeurIPS 2024) iTransformer / CycleiTransformer protocol: orig (iTransformer) vs +RCF (CycleiTransformer) vs +RG-Cycle, same recipe for all three.

gate.note: RG-only additions; gate parameters get 10x the epoch lr of the CycleNet schedule (own Adam group).

common_sources.n_heads: ACAT-SCUT/CycleNet@d807e51 run.py:71 (default 8; not set in scripts)
common_sources.optimizer: ACAT-SCUT/CycleNet@d807e51 exp/exp_main.py:56 optim.Adam(lr) (betas .9/.999, no weight decay)
common_sources.lradj: ACAT-SCUT/CycleNet@d807e51 run.py:96 (default type3; scripts do not set it) -> utils/tools.py:18; OneCycleLR constructed at exp/exp_main.py:135 sets epoch-1 lr to lr/25; adjust_learning_rate after each epoch at exp/exp_main.py:234-235
common_sources.early_stopping: ACAT-SCUT/CycleNet@d807e51 utils/tools.py EarlyStopping (strict improvement, delta 0); exp/exp_main.py:127,229-232
common_sources.val_loader: ACAT-SCUT/CycleNet@d807e51 data_provider/data_factory.py:31-32 (val uses the same branch) shuffle=True, drop_last=True; exp/exp_main.py vali(): np.average of per-batch MSE
common_sources.test_loader: ACAT-SCUT/CycleNet@d807e51 data_provider/data_factory.py:20-21 shuffle=False, drop_last=False (all test windows); metric = element-wise mean over all windows (utils/metrics.py)
common_sources.split_ETTh1: ACAT-SCUT/CycleNet@d807e51 data_provider/data_loader.py:49 12/4/4 months (8640/2880/2880 rows), StandardScaler fit on train rows
common_sources.split_custom: ACAT-SCUT/CycleNet@d807e51 data_provider/data_loader.py:247-248 70/10/20 with int(), StandardScaler fit on train rows
common_sources.cycle_index: ACAT-SCUT/CycleNet@d807e51 data_provider/data_loader.py:84,97 cycle_index[s_end] with np.arange(len(data)) % cycle
common_sources.factor: unused by FullAttention (no masking, mask_flag False)
common_sources.time_tokens: ACAT-SCUT/CycleNet@d807e51 exp/exp_main.py model(batch_x, batch_cycle): x_mark_enc=None, no timestamp tokens

cyclenet_code_behaviour.test_drop_last: False (data_factory.py:20-21): every test window is evaluated, so no deviation is needed here. Note the official iTransformer repo uses drop_last=True for test (thuml/iTransformer data_provider/data_factory.py:20-22); the iTransformer rows of CycleNet Table 4 are the iTransformer paper numbers.
cyclenet_code_behaviour.determinism: CycleNet seeds random/numpy/torch (run.py:110-113) but does not enable deterministic algorithms; TF32 left at PyTorch defaults (matmul off, cuDNN conv on).
cyclenet_code_behaviour.per_epoch_test_eval: CycleNet also evaluates the test set every epoch for logging only (exp_main.py:225); not repeated here.

source.batch_size/learning_rate/train_epochs/pa: thuml/iTransformer@c2426e6 run.py defaults: batch_size:63 (32) learning_rate:65 (1e-4) train_epochs:62 (10) patience:64 (3) dropout:52 (0.1)
source.note: CycleNet has no iTransformer/CycleiTransformer run on ETTh1 (Table 4 covers Electricity and Traffic only). The ETTh1 iTransformer script values are used inside the CycleNet training framework, the same way CycleNet ported the official iTransformer electricity/traffic scripts.
